snippet.title: Nsmbw mod: Super Mario Bros. Midnight [Release Trailer]
snippet.description:
ITS FINALY HERE i hope you all enjoy 
i spent a lot of time on this cant wait to
see people play this and agian i want to thank
everyone who showed interest and support.

Info:1 world mod
9 levels
new story
custom models
new themes
and more

Music in trailer by https://www.youtube.com/@SillyArcade/videos

Download:https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Tcr0nzEhMK5_Gy3myJjcEAslimc-JX3M/view?usp=drive_link 
Enjoy!
currently its really laggy on console so you will need to use dolphin to play it but a optimised version will be worked on so that it wont lag on console

Join my discord if your interesed in getting updates on more projects of mine https://discord.gg/BrBNa4jnrC
